Author: Serpens66
Name: Random Events
Description: Runs configurable Vanilla scenario events in singleplayer skirmishes and Trail missions.

Changes: Changes bandit and archer strength settings to decimal factors from 0.1 to 5.0 units per three elapsed game months and rolls them in 0.1 steps.
Persists the map-start absolute month and passes floor(elapsed months multiplied by the rolled factor divided by three) as the total unit count to both events.
Distributes manually spawned bandits across at most five groups and excludes keeps from their random building targets.
Works around reversed owner and sprite-color parameter labels in SHCDE-SE unit spawning by passing the reserved bandit owner first and Nature color zero second.
Logs and validates both r_ControllableForPlayerId and r_SpritePlayerColorId immediately after every bandit spawn.
Uses the first inactive regular player slot whose r_LordUnitId is zero as the owner of spawned bandits; skips the event without spawning if no slot is free.
Assigns the reserved slot a team distinct from every active human player while retaining Nature sprite color 0 for the macemen.
Creates delayed groups of at most five macemen, sets every tribe to Aggressive, and sends it with IssueMoveHereCommand to a random reachable target building.
Removes the complete delayed per-unit MoveToTile experiment, including its queue, target selection, guards, and logs.
Leaves each Nature-owned maceman untouched after CreateUnitLocal; only read-only Info diagnostics inspect its initial native state.
Retains the event presentation, minimap ActionPoint, and target-player popularity penalty without mutating spawned units.
Schedules one individual MoveToTile command per tribe-less bandit 0.5 seconds after native unit creation.
Selects a deterministic random living building of the human target player and moves each maceman to a free connected perimeter tile.
Skips the command if a unit acquires a tribe during initialization and logs scheduling plus execution while applying no stance change.
Removes the explicit Nature tribe creation and all tribe assignment from manually spawned bandit macemen.
Leaves every maceman unmodified after CreateUnitLocal while retaining an Info-level diagnostic of its native tribe, leader, owner, and AI state.
Confirms from runtime diagnostics that native bandit spawns initially have tribe ID 0 even while an AI player is active.
Creates exactly one Nature-owned tribe per bandit event and assigns every maceman from that spawn to the same tribe as an isolated grouping test.
Applies no stance, movement, attack, target, delayed action, or later runtime modification to the spawned macemen.
Logs the shared tribe ID and identifies tribe assignment as the only post-spawn action.
Restores manually spawned maceman sprite color and ownership to Nature (player 0) for an isolated ownership test.
Removes all post-spawn tribe creation, tribe assignment, stance changes, movement and attack orders, target assignment, retries, and runtime monitoring for spawned macemen.
Leaves each successfully created maceman completely untouched after CreateUnitLocal while retaining the event message, minimap ActionPoint, and Vanilla popularity penalty.
Temporarily assigns manually spawned bandit tribes, maceman ownership, and sprite color to player 8 for an explicit hostility test.
Verifies after Vanilla initialization that every spawned maceman is actually controlled by player 8; mismatches disable only further bandit events with a timestamped Error.
Keeps event targeting restricted to living human players despite the temporary bandit owner change.
Uses Vanilla's complete tribe MoveHere command so neutral macemen receive the normal movement AI and walking animation instead of sliding in their standing animation.
Keeps each bandit group in Hold stance while travelling and enables Aggressive only after at least half the living group reaches its destination beside the target building.
Assigns distinct target buildings to groups from the same event whenever available, reducing neutral-on-neutral target selection after arrival.
Places every neutral maceman spawned by one bandit event in a single Nature tribe, preventing aggressive Nature tribes from attacking each other.
Replaces the ineffective Attack Here tribe order with Vanilla's normal per-unit MoveHere order for logical groups of at most five macemen.
Moves each group to a free, walkable path tile beside its independently selected random target building or wall, then lets the shared aggressive tribe engage nearby enemies.
Fixes bandit events being skipped when the registered signpost center has no Vanilla path component.
Spawns neutral macemen on the nearest free, walkable perimeter tile of the selected signpost and uses that tile's nonzero Vanilla path component for reachable target selection.
Keeps compatibility failures isolated to bandit events and reports a timestamped Error when no valid signpost perimeter tile is available.
Replaces the normal building order, which Vanilla excludes for macemen, with Vanilla's melee-compatible Attack Here command 5 aimed at each group's random target building.
Activates Vanilla's original temporary bandit popularity penalty state 16 for the explicit human target player.
Resolves and validates the popularity-state write semantically after game DLL updates; incompatibility disables only the penalty while manual bandits and unrelated events remain active.
Replaces the ineffective force command 36 with an explicitly verified building-target command 9.
Exposes that Vanilla also rejects command 9 for neutral macemen, allowing the remaining unit-type restriction to be diagnosed instead of reporting a false activation.
Keeps later bandit events protected by disabling only this feature after a verified native command failure.
Replaces Vanilla's player-slot-8 bandit group completely with manually spawned neutral macemen owned by Nature (player 0).

Spawns the configured number at the closest validated signpost, splits them into groups of at most five, waits for Vanilla initialization, sets every group aggressive, and sends the groups to independently selected random living buildings of the target human player.
Keeps Vanilla's bandit text, Random_Events9.wav, action_bandits.bik, and clickable minimap ActionPoint while disabling only future bandit events if the managed tribe or unit APIs become incompatible.
Uses Vanilla path-connection regions to place or reuse signposts only when every active human player has at least one reachable living building or owned wall approach.
Removes unreachable or stale signposts from Vanilla's native event slots without deleting their map objects and restricts event targeting to the validated signpost set.

Targets only buildings reachable from the selected signpost and activates Nature-owned bandits with Vanilla's aggressive stance and forced building attack order; reachable owned walls are used when a closed castle exposes no building approach.
Orders each newly spawned Vanilla bandit tribe to attack a deterministic random living building of the selected human player through Vanilla's native tribe AttackBuilding command.
Disables only further bandit events with a timestamped Error if a game update makes tribe detection or the native attack-order API incompatible.
Adds Vanilla's clickable ActionPoint marker to the selected rabbit infestation source while keeping rabbit spawning independent if marker compatibility fails.
Defers initial event rolls until a human player has a living Lord, preventing an empty startup batch from delaying the first event by one full interval.
Confirms automatic signposts through Vanilla's full CreatePrefab placement rules and now exhausts alternative prefiltered positions when Vanilla rejects a preferred candidate.
Uses the correct Vanilla lion warning voice Random_Events14.wav and removes the obsolete Harmony-based Random_Events8.wav whitelist workaround.

Restores Vanilla's clickable minimap exclamation marker at each lion spawn by resolving and calling the native ActionPoint handler; only the marker is disabled with an Error if a game update breaks its compatibility validation.
Restricts prepared and executed events to active non-AI players with a living Lord while retaining explicit target IDs for future multiplayer synchronization.
Creates automatic signposts for Nature and protects the registered neutral signposts from indirect building-tile damage.
Fixes Vanilla rabbit tribes being blocked by a misidentified shared state value while preserving the native 160-rabbit limit and farm conditions.
Registers Vanilla's omitted Random_Events8.wav Scribe mapping so lion notifications play their existing voice line; only voice playback is disabled if managed compatibility validation fails.
Replaced the Lord-ID-only gate with a resolved Lord unit check that requires IsAlive, the Lord unit type, and ownership by the target player; removed periodic Lord-ID diagnostics.
Lion attacks now use Vanilla's native wildlife handler at the registered signpost closest to the target player's keep or living Lord and arm each created tribe with Vanilla's attack state.
Rabbit infestations now create a proper Vanilla rabbit tribe at one selected point within 12 tiles of an eligible farm, restoring Vanilla spreading and feeding behavior.
Resolves wildlife handlers, prerequisites, tile masks, and lion tribe layout semantically after game updates; only the incompatible rabbit or lion feature is disabled with an Error log.
Restored the 12-tile rabbit search radius and now spawns the complete rabbit group on one randomly selected valid tile so Vanilla movement spreads it naturally.
Skips every random event when the target player's r_LordUnitId is zero or player resources are unavailable.
Logs r_LordUnitId for all eight player slots at Info level every ten seconds while Random Events is active.
Reduced the rabbit infestation radius from 12 to 5 tiles so spawned rabbits form a much tighter group around the selected farm.

Centralized native signature validation around executable PE sections, added a fast validated path for the reference DLL, and isolated handler failures so compatible events remain available after small game updates.
Removed obsolete per-tick heartbeat and full-map prerequisite diagnostics from normal gameplay.

Restored wheat infestation, hops beetles, apple blight, mad cows, and granary theft through their validated native Vanilla effect handlers and original prerequisites without creating Timeline entries.
Queued the original Vanilla video and voice presentation after each successfully applied native event.
Replaced the non-working Vanilla rabbit event with a direct spawn of 10 to 50 neutral rabbits within 12 tiles of a random alive wheat or hops farm owned by the target player.
Removed the native rabbit signatures, gates, source-coordinate manipulation, signpost dependency, and delayed outcome audit.
Removed the non-running Script Extender coroutine dispatcher and all dependent Timeline queues, reusable entries, audits, and save-state fields.
Temporarily disabled the five Timeline-only events with one detailed error per active map while direct Vanilla events remain active.
Added a compact native-analysis handoff for the five Timeline action handlers and upgraded save data to V2.
Moved Timeline mutation to the shared persistent Script Extender dispatcher so all five Timeline-only events can be installed outside the native pre-tick hook.
Resolved and validated Vanilla's rabbit predicate, source array, global gate, count limit, spawner, and rejected-tile mask through semantic signatures.
Rabbit events now select four Vanilla-compatible source tiles near the target player's closest registered signpost and log every native gate decision at Info level.
Fixed a native map-start crash by moving Timeline creation and mutation out of the Script Extender's inline pre-tick hook into a persistent LateUpdate queue.
Added queued, executed, stale, and failed Timeline synchronization diagnostics.
Fixed event scheduling by using Vanilla's twelve-month calendar when the Script Extender reports zero months per year.
Fixed dynamically registered signposts as rabbit sources by supplying their positions through Vanilla's scenario-coordinate path.
Added delayed rabbit-unit outcome diagnostics and rejected saved schedules created with an incompatible calendar basis.
Added monthly and periodic game-time heartbeats to expose stalled or divergent Vanilla calendar readings.
Added before/after prerequisite snapshots for population, farms, granaries, food, rabbits, and registered signposts.
Added Timeline done-flag audits at the due tick and following tick before reusable event records are changed.
Added one emergency signpost search within 50 tiles of the map center when no usable edge signpost exists.
Skipped signpost-dependent events with an error when no registered signpost is available.
Prioritized the registered signpost nearest to the explicit target player's keep and prepared direct events for synchronized target player IDs.
Randomized new edge signposts between 2 and 12 tiles from the map edge and within 100 tiles of the safest candidate.
Preserved saved LobbyModSettings across development builds.
Moved real multiplayer and singleplayer skirmish/Trail detection into the shared GameModeHelper.
Fixed local skirmishes being mistaken for network games, which prevented all random events.
Reduced spacing in the strength controls and added horizontal scrolling for narrow settings views.
Made native signpost resolution tolerant of compatible game DLL updates by validating AOB and structural fallbacks.
If native validation fails, only automatic edge signposts are disabled and a detailed error is logged at Info-visible levels.
Added all 15 Vanilla random events for offline skirmishes and Trail missions.
Added saved deterministic scheduling and safe edge signposts for events that require them.
